fieldValues.chose:
WG Third-party ready: cycle 2026-11-22 11:30 to 2026-11-23 11:30 UTC
Pause state: running (the 11-20 and 11-21 reports carry a 👍; the 11-22 report has none yet, so one unacknowledged).

1. Decisions for you: one new escalation, 239a1705 (may the five spec-corpus source-document sidecars be corrected by hand, srs#1041?). Fact: all five spec source-document sidecars point contentPath the wrong way, so the engine reads each as a tombstone; the CLI has no sidecar-update command, and the rule is that data is never hand-edited around a tool gap. Why it matters: the spec repo is the first corpus a third party reads to learn the sidecar format, and it teaches the form the spec forbids. Options: allow a one-off hand edit of five keys (fast, but a precedent), or file the tool gap and park srs#1041 (slower, rule kept). Recommendation: file the gap and park unless you rule the exception. Action needed: decide. Urgency: low. Still waiting from earlier cycles: de6b88c5 (may the group merge a Door 3 revision that only executes a ratified ruling? It holds srs#1033 to #1037; first), 773ae4a6 (DOS timestamp of a deterministic .srs archive, 0x0000 or 1980-01-01), 864eaebf (srs#991, one heading-outline rule or opt-in per Composition), bc6bc746 (srs-web#691, is editor UI inside this mandate?), c7a8e0a2 (srs-rust#1497, may `note delete` refuse notes Relations point at?). Builder proposals: 21b6b4b7 (srs#236, oldest, 3+ weeks), 6882f577 (structured findings, srs-rust#1339). Action needed: decide or ratify. Also waiting for your merge: srs#1033 to #1037 (gate:owner-merge).

2. Decided within mandate: none ratified. Five PRs merged, but none carried a builder decision proposed as a record (the reviewers assented to local choices inside the PR decision blocks only), so no group session was held.

3. Done: 5 PRs merged, all in srs-rust, all with a quorum line (builder / reviewer / mandate):
- #1693 RFC-056 field filters in find: human:the-greenman / tpr-reviewer / 00567bf1 RFC-056 (Door 1, complicated)
- #1694 repo_settings two records mean no policy (I-111): tpr-builder / tpr-reviewer / I-111
- #1695 Container tags resolve against Vocabularies (I-65): tpr-builder / tpr-reviewer / I-65
- #1696 validate invariant 44, navigationLinks name declared sections: tpr-builder / tpr-reviewer / spec-invariant-44
- #1700 UTF-8 language encoding flag on every .srs entry (I-105): tpr-builder / tpr-reviewer / I-105
Every reviewer findings list reads "none". The first merges since 2026-11-14. #1700 changes bytes in semanticops.com public/try/, which lands with that repo's own pin advance.

4. Stuck or lost: open group PRs: srs#1021 (auto-merge, waiting); srs#1033 to #1037 (Door 3, wait on you); srs#1049 (conflicts with master, needs a rebase); srs-rust#1646 (waiting for review); srs-web#782 (waiting for review). Local reviewers noted the three root-only permission test failures are environmental (they pass non-root in CI). No red gate reported by a run. Escalation-log check (owner rulings in both logs): not re-read this cycle.

5. Budget: 5 of 10 delegated merges this cycle (counted from the merge times, 2026-11-22 11:30 to 2026-11-23 11:30; `clerk group-state` prints 0 because its cycleStart is already today's 11:30 when run at the close); 4 open delegated (srs#1021, #1049, srs-rust#1646, srs-web#782; the five Door 3 PRs do not count); room 5. Pause state: running.
5b. Awaiting ratification: 18 proposed decisions in the decision log (group and SemanticOps), oldest 21b6b4b7, filed 2026-10-30; the group's own are listed in section 1. Session to ratify: `clerk session --as owner --repo <srs-programme> --ratify all` (the-greenman/clerk; the TUI is `clerk --as owner`).

6. Next: ready by label: srs-rust 10, srs 2, srs-vscode 0, srs-web 1. Top 3 in Builder order (priority label, then oldest): srs-rust#1164 (RFC-045 readme carry), srs-rust#1495 (RFC-043 arrangement fixture in the corpus gate), srs-rust#1496 (retire text diagnostics lists). All P2. Open group PRs in flight: 4 delegated and 5 Door 3. Budget left: 5. Queue fed for about 1 cycle at the budget of 10 if all were workable. Waits on the owner: the escalations in section 1 and the five Door 3 merges. Fed by the analyst: 2026-11-20, filed 4 conformance issues, asked 1 ruling.

6b. Exercises: not re-read this cycle.

7. What we learned: the group merged again after 8 days, all Door 1 work executing recorded invariants, which held: reviewers cleared each on the invariant alone. The Door 3 PRs and the unanswered rulings are still what stops the rest. Measurement I1 (ec33a940, evidences linked): 0 of 0 PRs in the window, because the measure window opens at the 11:30 cycleStart and the close runs after it, so it is empty at every close (flagged since 2026-11-22; the script's window needs the close time, not now). Whether I1 is useful, noisy or misleading is yours to give in a session. I2 to I4: pending. Build trigger (srs-web#560): ready to unpark (far more than 10 ratified decisions).
